raw_text: Kera kabaye leta azunze umwe za Amerika nayirane, bashyize bagera ku masezerano yo guhagarika intambara ndetse no gufungura umuhoro amuza. Umaze amezi atatu ufunze? Ibintu byatumye ubuzima buhenda ibiciro by'ibikomoka kuri peyitahole n'ibindi bicuruzwa na byo birazamuka hirya no hino ku izi, ku mugoroba wo kurikiye icyumweru, perezida wa leta zunze umwesha Amerika Donald Trump yavuze ko ari inkuru ishimishije by'umwihariko ku munsi yizihizagaho imyaka mirongo inani, amaze avutse. Ayo masezerana hagati ya Amerika nayirande aje nyuma y'ibyumweru byinshi. by'ibiganiro, byabangirijwe n'agahenge kemejwe mu kwezi kuwa kane muri uyu mwaka, bikaba biteganyijwe ko amasezerano nyirizina azasinyirwa mu busubisi ku wa gatanu w'icyicyumweru. Mu buto umwa Donald Trump yashyize ku rubuga rwa truth social, yagize ateye hamwe no gufungura umuhoramuzi ndetse no gusinya amasezerino bizaba kuri uyu wa gatanun hazakurikiraho gutegura imitego iri muri oromuzi bityo amahoro n'ubucuruzi byongere bihinde mu karere kose no ku isi. Itangazo ryashyizwe hanze n'inama nkuru ishinzwe umutekano muri irani rivuga ko inyandiko y'amasezerano hagati y'ibihugu byombi iyo amaze gutegurwa, bivuze ko intambara igomba guhagarara mu bice byose bari bafitanyemo ibibazo harimo no muri  ribani aho ingabo za esirayeli zimaze iminsi zihanganye n'umutwe wa heza bola ukorana na irani. Ibihugu biri mu buhuza aribyo Pakisitani na Katari nabyo byemeje koko Amerika na Iran byamaze kwemeranya ku guhagarika intambara burundu byihinda iminsi mirongo itandatu y'agahenge, gufungura umuhoromuzi ndetse no gukora imbaraga. nziza mushinga w'icyoyeraniyemo itunganyije ayiranye izakoreshwa. Itangazwa ry'amasezerano mashya ryahise rijyana n'igabanuka ry'ibikomoka kuri peteroli mu biciro ku isoko, ku isoko mpuzamahanga aho akagunguru ka peteroli kahise kagabankaho kane n'ibice bine ku ijana kagera ku madorari mirongo inani n'atatu, mu masezerano ibihugu byombi byemeranijweho nkuko twabigarutse ho ni uko umuhoro muzi ugomba gufungurwa ingabo za ayirani zigahabwa iminsi mirongo itatu yo gukuraho imitego yose zari zashyize muri ormuze. Hazakurikiraho iminsi mirongo itandatu, ubwato butambuka nta kibazo, kandi irani ntiyemererwe ku busoresha? Nkuko yagiye ibivuga mu minsi yashize. Ingabo za Amerika nazo zari zaroherejwe ngo zihagarike ubwato bwa irani bwacaga mu muhoro bamuze. Nazo zizahava! Kubera ko icyaha abajyanye cyarangiye ibinyamakuru bitandukanye birimo kuvuga ko mu masezerano, Irani izemera kutazongera gusukura gahunda yayo y'ikorwa ry'intwaro z'ubumara, ari naho hazazamukira ibiganiro bigamije kureba ahazaza hayiraniyumi itunganyijwe ya irani igera ku biro magana ane na mirongo ine. Bivuga ko kimwe mu by'impande zombi zemera ari uko iyo iranimu izashwanyagurizwa aho ibitse, ikigo mpuzamahanga gishinzwe ingufu za nikereyare kigakora ubugenzuzi bugamije kureba uko bishyirwa mu bikorwa. Ibivugwa muri aya masezerano biramutse bishyizwe mu bikorwa byashyira iherezo ku izamuka ry'ibiciro rimaze iminsi irigaragaza hirya no hino ku isi ndetse n'iherezo kuri iyi ntambara yari maze iminsi irengo ijana, kubera ifungwa rya oromuzi inyuramo makumyabiri ku ijana by'ibikomoka kuri peteroli, byagize ingaruka ku biciro bya gaze na peteroli nabyo bigira uruhare mu kwiyongera ku ibiciro by'ibindi bicuruzwa. Irane yihimuye kandi igabaye ibitero ku bihugu by'abarabu bikorana na Amerika birimo n'ibisanzwe bifite ukuboko kunini mu bucuruzi bw'ibikomoka kuri peteroli, mbere gato itangazwa ryayo amasezerano byari bigiye kwitambukwa n'ibitero Isirayeli yagabya mu majyaruguru ya mbeya hute umurwa mukuru wa ribani, ni ibitero Isilayeli ivuga ko yihimbura aho ku mutwe wa hezobora wari wabarasheho icyo akora byarakaje cyane perezida Donald Trump kubera ko yabifashe nko gushaka kumuteranya na irane mu gihe ibiganiro byari bigeze heza hano ni byiza kwibuka ko umubyeyi irani yasabye harimo ko intambara ihagarara muri irani no muri  ribani, kandi ko kurenga ku ngingo n'imwe y'ayo masezerano bisobanuye kurenga kumasezerano yose muri rusange. Ibiganiro bya Amerika na irani byatwaye umwanya kubera ko byasabye ko abahuza barimo Pakisitani na Katari bamara amasaha cumi narindwi muri tera bagoragoza kugira ngo barebe uko impande zombi hari icyo zasiga zemeranijeho nyuma yo gusoza akazi kabo neza ubimyiteguro irarimbanyije kugirango ibihugu byombi bizashyire umukono ku masezerane. kuri uyu wa gatanu. Mu gihe irani yashyira mu bikorwa ibyo yasabwe, bivugwa ko nayo izakomorerwa cyane cyane bahereye ku mafaranga yayo yafatiriwe mu mahanga kubera ibihano yashyiriweho na Amerika. Ngo nta mafaranga zagenda ari kurwagahoro gahoro bijyanye n'ubushake nayo iyo agaragaje mwishyirwa mu bikorwarwa ryayo amasezerano. Amerika kandi yemerewe irani ko mu minsi mirongo itandatu agahenge kazamara izaba yemerewe kugurisha ku isoko mpuzamahanga peteroli yayo kandi iyo minsi nayo izagenda yongerwa bijyanye n’uko irani zitwara. Ubusanzwe ntabwo iirani yari yemerewe gupfa kugurisha peteroli yayo ku isoko mpuzamahanga, imwe mu ngingo zatumye no kumvikana bigorana ni ukwinjiza ibibazo bya Isilayeli na heza, n'ukwinjiza  ibibazo  bya Israel na hezobora mu biganiro. Nubwo na hejuru bora yabujijwe kongera kurahasa muri Ailani. Muri make Amerika bayitegiye kuri Isirayeri kugira ngo bemere ko ibyo yiyemeje bizajya mu bikorwa koko. Iki gitekerezo kijya gusa n'icyari cyatanzwe mbere n'intumwa ya perezida don'uwo turampo mu burasirazuba bwo hagati Steve Witkofe ndetse n'umukwe wa Donald Trump Jared Kushnel aba mu biganiro bya mbere bari basezeranyije irani ko Amerika izashyira mu kigega amafaranga y'ishoramari, mu gihe irani  izaba yemewe gusaba kose kwa Amerika. Ngo muri iryo shoramari hateganwaga ko banywe mu bashoramari n'ibigo by'ubucuruzi byo muri Amerika bizoherezwa gukorera muri irani, bigafatanya n'ibindi bigo bigenze ibya byo byo muriki gihugu. Icyiciro cya kabiri cy'ibiganiro kizakomeza nyuma yisindwa ry'amasezerano y'ibanze ni ikijyanye no kuganira ku hazaza hayiraniiyumi itunganyijwe ya irani, nkuko tugeze ku bigaruka wo mu kanya. Mu ntangiriro perezida Donald Trump yasabwaga ko iyo iraniyiyo ivanwa muri Iran, ikajyanwa muri Amerika mu gihe iraniye ishaka ko bayigabanyiriza ubukana ikoherezwa mu kindi gihugu kitara Amerika. Iki gitekerezo cya irani mu cy'umweru gishize perezida Donal Trump yavuze ko nta cyo gitwaye, hapfa kuba hatarimo kohereza iyo iraninyimu mu Bushinwa cyangwa se mu Burusiya, ibijyanye na iraniyimyu n'intwarokirimbuzi n'ibimara kujya mu buryo nibwo iraniyizakomorerwa ikabona ku mafaranga yayo yafatiriwe mu mahanga. Irani ivuga ko nibura harimo iriya makumyabiri n'enye z'amadolari zafatiriwe mu mahanga kubera ibihano bya Amerika, ikaba yaragiye isaba ko ayo mafaranga abanza kurekurwa ikabona kwinjira mu biganiro. Kubanza kurekura amafaranga ya Irani yafatiriwe Donald Trump yagiye abyirinda cyane kubera ko biri mubyo yanenze ubutegetsi bwa Barack Obama, aho bwigeze kurekurira Iran hafi imiliyaha ebyiri z'amadorari ngo irekuru Abanyamerika bane yari yafashe, byatumye Donald Trump abigenderaho mu gusebwe ubutegetsi bwa Barack abavuga ko ubuzima bw'abanyamerika bwaguranywa amafaranga kugira ngo irani ikomeze gucurura intwarokirimbuzi. Ibiciro bigatumbagira, ubutegetsi bwa iranini buvuga ko nubwo hari bimwe mu byo abaturage bigaragarabya bavuga byumvikana ngo harimo inteko z'ibihugu by'amahanga nta Amerika irimo bibyihisha inyuma.

Amerika yifuza ko Irani yajya mu maboko y'abayobozi bashya bayumva cyane, ku isonga yabo Amerika ishaka guha ubutegetsi harimo Reza Paravi. Igikoma ngombwa cya Muhamedi Reza Parave. Umwe abanyamerika basubije ku butegetsi mu gihumbi na maganakene na mirongo itanu na gatatu? Uyu muhungwe ubutegetsi bwase bwahirizwa afite imyaka cumi n'irindwi. Yari yaragiye kwiga muri Amerika kuvugwo ntabwo yagarutse muri irani aracyarimwe ubuhungiro ikigaragara ni uko kubusubiraho byo bidashoboka. Iyo yisigaye ni ukuyobokaga ubutegetsi bw'aba ayatora mugenzi ko ari ibyo

Yihaye amasezerano mashya yaba ashyizwe mu bikorwa uko yakabaye kubera ko guhindura ubutegetsi bwayirane, ibyo birasa n'ibitazashoboka nkuko bitashobotse mu meza anashize, incutiba ku nzi mudasiba kudukurikira. Ikiganiro cyacu cya none natugisoreje, naho utaha.

Niba utarabyitegereza neza uzaba irebe, icupa riri mu bikoresho uzabona ahantu hose uzagera haba mu rugo, mu kazi, mu maduka, mu modoka z'abantutu iryavuyemo ji, irya amazi, irya soda, irya byeri, igi ijishikaje cyane hano ariko ntabwo ari icupa, ahubwo ni ibirijyamo n'uburyo bijyamo. Ibi nitwe tubikora twebwe na vani mashini.
Turi uruganda rukora imashini zikora ibirebana no gufunga ibisukika mu macupa, kuva kukubishyiramo, gupfundikira, gushyiraho ibirango byose mukanya gato cyane.
Izi inganda nyinshi ubona zikora ibyo kunywa n'ibindi bisukika inyinshi muri zo zikoresha imashini zacu twebwe na vani mashine.
Tumaze imyaka myinshi, iyi myaka myinshyi cyane dufasha abanyenganda zikora  ibyo  kunywa kubikorana isuku, kinyamwuga, vuba kandi muburyo bwunguka.
Imashini zacu zirizewe cyane mu gushyira mu macupa za ji, fanta, byeri, kombuca, amavuta, ubuki, amasosi akorewe mu nganda n'ibindi.

Niba ushaka gutangiza uruganda rukora ibinyobwa cyangwa se ibindi bisukika ukeneye na vani mashine kubera ko tukugurisha imashini abayinjeniyeri bacu bagahita bazenzitara iwawe mu gihe gito bagahugura abakozi bawe mu kuzikoresha kandi bagakomeza gukurikirana izo mashini umunsi ku wundi bakanaha abakozi bava inama.
zihoraho muri na vanimashini ntabwo twubake imashini ni nziza gusa ahubwo dukabya inzozi zawe zo kuba umunyenga ndawunguka.
